chunks: Surely, there is a strong shield of Allah over me. When my day would come it would get away from me and hand me over to death. At that time neither an arrow would go amiss nor a wound would heal up.
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of the divine shield protecting Imam Ali from death?
ai.summary: In this passage from *Nahj al-Balagha*, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) articulates the concept of *habs al-waqt* (detention of time), where a divine shield prevents his premature assassination until his divinely appointed hour of martyrdom. This ensures that his death occurs only when the arrow strikes its intended mark, fulfilling the prophetic tradition that 'no arrow shall miss its mark,' thereby validating the inevitability of his fate as recorded in Shia historiography.
